vik: FYI i'm going to add a short 'Autoscale policy migration' subsection under Dedicated Provisioning. Purpose: help teams migrate from legacy "scale_by_rps" policies to new "metric-based" policies without downtime. will include a tiny CLI + python SDK example and a 5-step rollforward/rollback cheat-sheet. cc @nora @sam for wording.

nora: love it. please be explicit about the migration semantics: we should keep the legacy policy active during the migration window, mirror traffic for 5-10m, then switch routing. mention cooldowns and a safety net (auto-revert) if p95 regresses.

sam: add the exact CLI flow we expect ops to run. something like: export current policy -> create new metric-based policy -> attach to provision (dry-run) -> mirror traffic -> promote. include commands for reassigning tenants if pool incompatibility shows up.

vik: draft CLI + SDK snippets below (very small). plan to keep prose under ~200 words.

CLI flow (copy/paste):
```
# export existing policy
redwood-cli policy get --id legacy-policy-123 > legacy-policy.json

# create new metric-based policy
redwood-cli policy create --file metric-policy.yaml

# attach in dry-run mode (no traffic cut)
redwood-cli provision attach-policy --provision-id p-abc123 --policy new-metric-policy --dry-run

# mirror traffic for 10m, monitor p95/error. if ok, promote
redwood-cli provision promote-policy --provision-id p-abc123 --policy new-metric-policy

# if regress, revert
redwood-cli provision revert-policy --provision-id p-abc123 --policy legacy-policy-123
```

Python SDK snippet (minimal):
```
from redwood import DedicatedClient
c = DedicatedClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
# create metric policy
mp = c.policies.create({"name":"metric-mig","type":"metric-based","metric":"p95_latency_ms","target":250})
# attach dry-run
c.provisionings.attach_policy("p-abc123", mp.id, dry_run=True)
```

vik: suggested 5-step cheat-sheet for the docs (pasteable):
- snapshot legacy policy and note current thresholds
- create metric-based policy with conservative targets (start slightly looser)
- attach in dry-run and mirror 100% of canary traffic for N minutes
- promote if metrics stable; otherwise revert and adjust targets
- when stable, schedule deprecation of legacy policy (announce + 7-day window)

docs-ci-bot: docs build passed for PR draft #5012. 1 link suggestion: update /ops/infra/terraform/provisioning to point to README.md.

nora: tiny wording nit: call out cooldown example (cooldown_seconds: 120) and that mirroring should be at least 5 minutes but no more than 30 to limit cost. add a short line about isolation labels: some pools will reject mirror due to eviction_precedence. link to eng-sre runbook.

vik: perfect. i'll push a small PR with snippets + cheat-sheet + link fixes in ~15m. thanks :thumbsup:
